settings.intro: Everything you need to know about getting your order to you.
settings.cta_text: Still need a hand? We're happy to help.

settings.title: Where we ship
settings.text: We currently ship to the USA and the Philippines.

settings.title: Shipping options
settings.text: The shipping options and prices available to you are shown at checkout, based on your address.

settings.title: Tracking
settings.text: You'll get a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships.

settings.title: Delivery times
settings.text: Delivery times vary by destination and the shipping option you choose, so you can compare options at checkout.
